Verify actual Figma effective rendering including ancestor transforms/clips, fill mode, opacity, blend modes, masks, effects, hidden/duplicate photographic layers. Hiding registered text must recover the exact approved source; a retained but covered source node is insufficient.

Compare every output pixel against an independently rendered expected composition, not only core or rectangles. Alpha-zero regions must equal source exactly, including all product edges and background; alpha-positive regions must equal expected composition. Fix renderer/color-space/rounding semantics; no undocumented tolerance or cosmetic core restoration.

Reject missing/substituted alpha, shifted glyph alpha, unregistered overlay, source/transform/filter changes and unexplained one-channel differences; include legitimate foreground-text positive control and V1-21 regression checks. Run the real V22+ validator, not only a copied policy simulation.

Math does not establish that product remains legible or its materials/light/composition remain perceptually protected. Actual fresh image review must reject excessive occlusion or loss of product identity; preserve existing aesthetic bar and final human acceptance.
